Karma Levels Explained

Positive Karma

  • 100+: Saint
  • 50-99: Good
  • 10-49: Neutral+

Negative Karma

  • -10 to 9: Neutral
  • -50 to -11: Neutral-
  • -100 to -51: Evil
  • -100-: Demon

Reputation Levels Explained

Positive Reputation

  • 80+: Revered
  • 60-79: Honored
  • 40-59: Friendly
  • 20-39: Neutral

Negative Reputation

  • 0-19: Unfriendly
  • -20 to -1: Hostile
  • -20-: Hated
